limitations: Research profile has no physical validation or calibrated decision thresholds.
Engineering bounds are resource and diagnostic defaults, not qualified optical acceptance thresholds.
All four print-process branches are experimental and share an initial residual descriptor; none is qualified.
Content suppression does not establish physical-instance identity; same-content reprints remain a required control.
A surface observation cannot establish contents, closure, custody, or absence of reopening.
Optional angular, platform-attestation, and learned channels are unavailable in this baseline.
